literal: Suddenly themselves having looked, themselves indeed weep; this to laugh worthy of possesses.
translation: Having eagerly looked on their own, my eyes now weep by themselves; this is truly something to be laughed at.
modern: விரைவாகத் தாமாகவே பார்த்துவிட்டு, இப்பொழுது தாமாகவே அழுகின்ற என் கண்களின் இந்தச் செயல், சிரிப்பிற்குரிய தன்மையைக் கொண்டிருக்கிறது.
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine speaks of the irony of her eyes' behavior. The eyes eagerly and hastily rushed to look at her lover when he was near. Now that he is away, those very same eyes weep in deep sorrow and longing. She remarks that this self-inflicted grief is highly amusing and worthy of mockery, as the eyes themselves brought about this pain by looking in the first place.
